clips.text: All right. I am here. Tell me if you want anything different.
There it is. That smile was worth waiting for.
One more, Your Majesty? The sweetest one is yours.
I will arrange the seats. Nobody has to stay longer than they want.
I would like the seat beside you. I can ask nicely.
Then let me make a little room for you. The schedule can wait.
I will bring the music. And I promise to let the others speak.
I only ask that Her Majesty gets a moment to rest.
Before midnight, Your Majesty, there is something you must know.
You can tell me what you need. I will listen before I act.
Someone entered your chambers. I intend to learn who.
I will keep to what you have asked. Nothing more.
I wrote a song about your breakfast. I regret nothing.
We can take our time. Your comfort comes first.
I promise not to brag. Much.
Of course. You do not owe me your time or a reason.
A gift from you would mean more than anything in the treasury.
I came here for the wrong reasons. That changed.
I did not make the token glow. Stop staring.
A small moment can outlast a very long night.
Your choice. I intend to make it worth your time.
I want to stay. Only if you want me here.
Now that is a moment worth remembering. I will spare you the rhyme.
The crown chose you because you can break it.
Let us take it one step at a time and see what we find.
I thought you might want these. I hoped you would.
Thank you for telling me. I would rather hear the truth.
I was jealous. I am sorry. That does not excuse it.
I miss you. I was hoping you might miss me too.
Someone used the crown’s true name against me.
If we are competing, gentlemen, at least make it beautiful.
She rules the stars and all the sea—and nobody saves a dance for me.
No audience, unless you want one. This moment is ours.
Don’t drink that! This is a memory seal!
It wasn’t an assassin. The crown killed him.
History did not forget her. Someone erased her.
The spell was not born evil. It was rewritten.
No secret is worth losing your freedom.
I stay because I love you. Not because a crown commands me.
Of course. You do not owe me your time or a reason.
That thing is alive. Get behind me!
Are you hurt? Good. Then I did my job.
He is not allowed to leave us. Not like this.
Give me the crown. I will return your knight.
A title cannot tell me who to love. I choose you.
Of course. You do not owe me your time or a reason.
The crown cannot command a heart freely given.
Did I miss anything? I promised I would stay.
Keep the throne. Let them keep their hearts.
I have feelings. Apparently the schedule does not.
I made dessert. I may have written your name in sugar.
I saved a little of the good part for you.
I will honor your choice, even if I wish it were me.
Twelve men, one breakfast table. This is my next hit.
Of course. You do not owe me your time or a reason.
No one will ever choose your life for you again.
You set the pace. I am glad to share it.
Whichever you choose, it will be yours.
Of course. You do not owe me your time or a reason.
You broke the first crown. Do you know where the second sleeps?
Morning, gorgeous. Who gets to spoil you today?
Honey, two drops. I remembered.
Of course. Take the time you need.
I brought grapes. And a very convincing smile.
Of course. Take the time you need.
Tell me if my hands are too rough.
Of course. Take the time you need.
I saved the first silver rose for you.
Of course. Take the time you need.
I am not here to beg. I am here because I chose you.
Of course. Take the time you need.
I should be praying. Instead, I am worried about you.
Of course. Take the time you need.
One dance. No crowns. Just you and me.
This palace needs a better schedule. Or a referee.
Of course. Take the time you need.
Of course. Take the time you need.
The answer is hidden in what nobody bothered to read.
I grew these roses because you said you liked white.
Of course. Take the time you need.
You rule all day. May I look after you tonight?
Of course. Take the time you need.
I wrote you a song. Twelve, actually.
Of course. Take the time you need.
I can protect your secrets, but I will not choose for you.
Of course. Take the time you need.
I made these just for you.
Of course. Take the time you need.
Of course. Take the time you need.
Of course. Take the time you need.
The stars are unusually jealous tonight.
Hold still, Your Majesty. Almost perfect.
Of course. Take the time you need.
Even the griffin likes you.
Of course. Take the time you need.
These blooms open only for you.
Of course. Take the time you need.
I made it snow, only where you asked.
Would you like your shoulders relaxed?
Of course. Take the time you need.
I made this scent for one person alone.
Of course. Take the time you need.
Would you let me feed you just one?
You look tense. May I help?
Honey, two drops. As always.
I saved this bloom for you.
I made this because you asked. Do not tell anyone.
May I have this dance?
You don’t have to be brave every minute.
One move, Your Majesty. Impress me.
Let me make tonight easier.
I wanted to be better than yesterday.
Everyone is going to hate this chorus.
I thought of you before I thought of the throne.
A taste test, Your Majesty?
The stars refuse to name him.
Look closely. I hid something for you.
He likes you more than he likes me.
The rain sounds prettier from here.
Only here. Only for you.
No one else will wear this blend.
I am off duty. Would you like some company?
